lines.text: Subject: KO-410 drums thick this morning
The KO-410 drums are very thick this morning, it is -4 °C outside. Do we
need longer in the hot box?
Reply from R. Ferrandi: Thick, not crystallised. KO-410 viscosity at 15 °C
is about 21,000 mPa·s - still pumpable with the gear pump. I checked two
